headline: September Windows update breaks domain logins, then gets a workaround
summary: Three reports on one running story: the September Windows 11 security update is rejecting valid domain credentials on some enterprise systems, and Microsoft has since shared a temporary fix. One outlet names a cause and the condition under which it bites; another reports only that Microsoft was investigating.
